# Nysa Technology

> Hands-on virtual CISO (vCISO) and compliance execution firm. Nysa builds and runs security compliance programs directly — SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR, NIST CSF, and PCI-DSS — rather than just advising on them.

## What Nysa Technology does

Nysa Technology is a hands-on vCISO and compliance services provider for small and mid-sized companies, primarily SaaS and healthcare-adjacent businesses that need to reach or maintain a compliance certification. Unlike advisory-only consultants, Nysa's team implements controls, writes policies, manages audits, and stays engaged through certification and beyond.

Core services:
- Hands-On vCISO: end-to-end build of a security program from gap assessment through first certification.
- Compliance frameworks supported: SOC 2 (Type I and Type II), HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 (AI management systems), GDPR, NIST CSF, PCI-DSS.
- ISO 27001 & ISO 42001 Internal Audits: independent, standalone internal audits (clause 9.2) for companies whose ISMS/AIMS already exists, including programs built by other consultants.
- HIPAA Security Risk Assessment: an independent, third-party risk analysis following the HHS/OCR Security Risk Assessment methodology — a gap assessment, not a certification or Type I/II audit — with optional follow-on remediation support.
- Ongoing compliance management, policy development, and audit management for companies maintaining an existing certification.

## Who this is for

Companies preparing for their first compliance certification, companies that built a compliance program in-house or with another consultant and need an independent auditor, and companies that already hold a certification and need the periodic internal audit or risk assessment required to keep it.
